name: Mohammad Montasim Al Mamun Shuvo
title: Senior Software Engineer | React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript | Real-Time & AI-Driven SaaS
tagline: Building deterministic, high-performance web platforms for real-time and AI-driven applications.
about:
Most software looks great in the demo. I build the kind that survives production.

I'm a **Senior Software Engineer** with **3+ years** building real-time, AI-driven, multi-tenant SaaS platforms across the full stack — React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. Promoted twice at the same company, I now own frontend architecture across a multi-service platform, lead PR reviews, and mentor the engineers behind me.

Key highlights: cut cloud infrastructure costs **70%** by migrating Azure VMs to App Service with automated CI/CD. Boosted application performance **40%** and hit **Lighthouse 90+** by replacing legacy libraries with custom components. Built a real-time **computer vision** pipeline (MediaPipe) sustaining **60 FPS** at **99.9% reliability**, and designed a deterministic **finite-state-machine** engine that eliminated race conditions during live AI analysis.

Here's what makes my work different: most engineers build for the happy path. I build for the moment it all goes wrong — predictable state transitions, resilient lifecycles, and async workflows that don't leak, stall, or surprise you. Reliability isn't something I bolt on at the end; it's the architecture I start with.
